table_context: Nutrition facts table printed on a curved juice bottle label, photographed at an angle in a grocery store.
Hand-ruled accounting ledger page from a 1912 municipal archive scan, with faded ink and a stamp overlaying the lower rows.
Printed departure timetable photographed on a station notice board, slightly inclined with reflections on the glass cover.
Product specification table printed on the side of a cardboard shipping carton, photographed in a warehouse under uneven lighting.
Printed class score sheet scan with a merged header cell spanning all four columns and several empty score cells.
Dosage-by-age table on a folded medicine box, photographed with the box partially rotated so the table is inclined and one corner is occluded by a thumb.
Multi-color wall menu board with wired price columns, photographed from below with strong perspective distortion.
Billing summary table from a scanned utility bill, with a row-header column on the left and a merged 'Total' cell spanning two columns in the last row.
Extremely wide inventory chart photographed across a warehouse office wall, an extreme-aspect-ratio table with small handwritten entries.
Fee table on a crumpled parking receipt, curved and partially blurred, with the header row printed in inverted colors.
